rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded day-5 blastocyst with B-grade ICM, good TE, thinned zona, and possible partial collapse; appropriately notes limits of a single static image. Minor overreach in questioning whether TE is truly A-grade.
Strong integration of age, ovarian reserve, stimulation response, male-factor context, prior miscarriage, BMI, smoking/alcohol, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-supported, with a reasonable prognosis range tied to embryo grade and patient factors. Minor inconsistency from giving several overlapping probability ranges and some speculative comments about cavity issues.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading and mainstream IVF guidance, including caution about morphology not predicting ploidy and not routinely recommending PGT-A at age 26. Slight deviation in suggesting double embryo transfer discussion in a young good-prognosis patient.

Provides practical next steps including smoking/alcohol cessation, cavity evaluation if needed, selective miscarriage workup, sperm DNA fragmentation consideration, and future-cycle planning. Useful but not highly protocol-specific.
